mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t.* FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN task_assignees ta ON ta.task_id = t.id WHERE t.is_deleted = false AND t.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CANCELLED') AND ( (t.task_type = 'TODO' AND t.creator_id = #{userId}) OR (t.task_type = 'WBS_TASK' AND ta.user_id = #{userId}) ) ORDER BY FIELD(t.priority, 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW'), t.end_date IS NULL, t.end_date, t.created_at DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT t.* FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN task_assignees ta ON t.id = ta.task_id WHERE t.is_deleted = false AND t.task_type = 'EVENT' AND t.start_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND (t.end_date >= CURDATE() OR (t.end_date IS NULL AND t.start_date >= CURDATE())) AND (t.creator_id = #{userId} OR ta.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY t.start_date

SELECT DISTINCT t.* FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN task_assignees ta ON t.id = ta.task_id WHERE t.is_deleted = false AND t.task_type = 'WBS_TASK' AND t.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CANCELLED') AND t.start_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (t.end_date >= CURDATE() OR (t.end_date IS NULL AND t.start_date >= CURDATE())) AND (t.creator_id = #{userId} OR ta.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY t.end_date IS NULL, t.end_date, t.start_date
